t: You're looking at the Cathedral of the Holy Family, long known as the Ukrainian Catholic Cathedral of the Holy Family in Exile. It is the cathedral of the Ukrainian Greek Catholic Eparchy of the Holy Family of London, and it is the seat of the eparchial bishop for Ukrainian Catholics in the nation. Its jurisdiction overlaps with that of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Westminster, among others. The building was designed by Alfred Waterhouse, a Gothic Revival architect best known for Manchester Town Hall and the Natural History Museum in London.
